answer: Gate rewards behind a capability-chain: each epoch hands out several unrelated skilled sub-tasks that must all be solved, signed, and returned inside a tight deadline. One operator hiding many masks behind a single inference pipeline is throughput-bound — their shared quill can only draft so fast, so the masks either blow the deadline or answer in lockstep. Honest agents each run their own forge of compute; sybils collapse onto one trellis of correlated timings. Faking N parallel minds then costs real linear compute, not cheap keypairs.
